title: Choose the visual world for navin.
question: Re-roll 1: the roll assigned Graduation Tarp. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Graduation Tarp
options.lineage: Filipino printed vinyl tarpaulins for graduations and achievements
options.thesis: The portfolio as the tarp hung outside the house: a public, proud announcement of who Navin is and what he has earned.
materials: printed vinyl with grommeted corners and a faint weave
full-height portrait cut-out on a saturated field
options.viewport: A royal-blue vinyl field edge to edge: Navin's portrait large on the left, NAVIN in heavy marigold display caps, then BS Computer Science · Lyceum of the Philippines University – Manila as the credential line; the race button and email sit on the tarp's bottom band.
options.risk: Tips into kitsch if rendered with clip-art gradients; it must be set like a confident print job, not a party flyer.

raised.raise: Folded and deployed are real states: the tarp arrives rolled and unfurls once, and sections open as panels from their crease.
Everything is measured against one grid unit, from grommet spacing to type size and gutters.
Every entry carries a date band: experience, certificates and projects are banded with when, like printed achievement strips.
Honest small chrome: the race tally and the last result appear as plain counters on the tarp, never as decoration.

options.label: LRT Line Signage
options.lineage: Manila LRT/MRT station signage and line maps
options.thesis: Navin's career as a transit line: every section is a station on one colored route.
options.viewport: A wayfinding header panel reading NAVIN with station tiles for Projects, Experience, Stack and Certifications.
options.risk: Familiar: wayfinding-as-portfolio is a well-worn move, and the typing race has no natural station.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: NAVIN built cell by cell on a visible construction grid; the page is the proof of craft.
options.viewport: Enormous grid-constructed NAVIN across the top, a small neutral grotesk bio and project index below.
options.case: Holds product clarity, because it shows front-end craft directly; weaker recruiter identification.
options.risk: Can read as a type-design portfolio rather than a developer's.

options.label: CD-ROM Console
options.thesis: A rendered console with embossed toggles; each section plays in the central window.
options.viewport: Console frame with Projects/Experience/Stack/Certs/Race toggles around a window showing Navin's portrait.
options.case: Holds clarity, since sections are unmistakable toggles; loses identification and long-text reading.
options.risk: No free-flowing text is a poor fit for project descriptions.

options.label: Miura Fold Sheet
options.thesis: The portfolio unfolds from a packet into a tessellated sail.
options.viewport: A gold packet that deploys into the page.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no tie between origami engineering and Navin.
options.kept: Folded and deployed as real states.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.thesis: Typing speed as a live phosphor trace.
options.viewport: A graticule showing the race as a waveform.
options.case: Fuses poorly and lands in the dark-glow rut.

options.label: Brine Calendar
options.thesis: Skills as jars maturing over time.

options.label: Minihompy Room
options.thesis: Identity as a furnished isometric room.
options.viewport: An isometric room with a visitor counter.
options.kept: Honest small chrome: counters state real facts.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photo, name and tagline split hero; a grid of project cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other student portfolios by design.
